Subject: Renewal paperwork sync: term swap + staged capacity onboarding

Hi Sarah / team,

Thanks again for the productive renewal call last week. Per our conversation, we're preparing paperwork to: 
- shift from a 12mo to an 18mo term (aligned with your fiscal cadence)
- add a phased capacity uplift: +20% immediate, +30% at month 6, +50% at month 12 (see SOW draft)

Attached are the current SOW (Infrapoint_SOW_v3.docx) and the blank order form (Redwood_OrderForm_v5.pdf). Before we loop Legal, wanted to confirm two operational points so we minimize back-and-forth: 
1) Bill run: do you want the uplift invoiced pro rata at each stage or consolidated at month 12?
2) Term effective date: are you expecting the 18mo term to start on 2028-07-01 or the signature date?

If those align, I'll ask Legal to prepare a limited MSA amendment (term swap + ordering schedule) and we'll circulate redlines. Goal: sign by end of May so onboarding can start July 1.

Thanks —
Avery

Hi Avery —

Thanks for the summary. Quick answers: 
- Procurement prefers pro rata billing at each uplift milestone (easier for our monthly forecasting).
- Effective date should be signature date; finance wants billing tied to the signed commitment.

Two asks from our side before you send anything to legal: 
1) Can you confirm the SLA credit calculations won't change with the staged uplift? We need confirmation that baseline latency/uptime SLAs are preserved and credits scale (not decrease) with additional capacity.
2) We will need a short clause about data residency for the new capacity in us-west-2 (we're adding additional endpoints there).

I've looped procurement; they'll expect the signed order form and an MSA amendment clean copy for internal review.

Best —

Team / Sarah —

Thanks for the clear ask. I've drafted an amendment that captures the three commercial points and included a short Data Residency clause (we reference customer-configured region + KMS key if they opt for CMEK). A few legal points that need confirmation before I circulate: 
- Billing milestones: do you want invoicing issued at the start of each uplift window or on achievement of usage thresholds? (i.e., invoice at month 6 vs invoice when usage hits X tokens). Ben noted procurement prefers fixed milestone invoices — please confirm.
- SLA credits: our standard language applies credits against monthly service fees. To preserve their economics, I'll add a sentence that scales the credit cap proportionally to contracted capacity if that helps (I kept this optional in the draft).
- Data residency: we will commit capacity in us-west-2 but need to reserve the right to shift compute within the same region for load balancing — will that be acceptable? If Infrapoint requires a hard physical carve-out, we need a separate procurement/ops conversation about dedicated capacity.

Next steps: I can circulate the redline today if you confirm the two billing points and the residency tolerance.

Markus Klein
Lead Counsel, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Hi Sarah / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. To confirm from our side: 
- Billing: Infrapoint requested pro rata milestone invoicing. We'll issue invoices at the start of each uplift window (month 0, month 6, month 12) per your preference. If you prefer usage-triggered invoicing, say so and we'll adjust.
- Term effective date: signature date — confirmed.
- SLA credits: Markus has added optional language to scale credits with capacity. We'll keep that in the redline and you can accept/remove it.
- Data residency: our standard approach is region binding with operational flexibility to reassign within the same AZ/region for resiliency. If you require dedicated physical capacity we can open a separate thread (Dedicated capacity add-on) — that will be a contract & procurement conversation.

Markus is circulating the redline now (MSA_infrapoint_redline_20280513.docx). Monica will attach an updated SOW with the exact uplift numbers by EOD tomorrow. After your review, procurement can route internally and we can set DocuSign room for signature. Proposed timeline: legal review by 5/19, internal procurement sign-off 5/24, signature by 5/31.

Action items: 
- Monica: attach updated SOW (EOD 5/16)
- Sarah / procurement: confirm milestone invoicing OK (reply-all)
- Markus: circulate final redline and call out any non-negotiable clauses
